high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a webpage from the "Founders Fund," as indicated by the logo at the top left corner. The page is titled "Choose Good Quests" and discusses the concept of quests in life, drawing parallels to historical achievements such as the Wright Brothers' quest for the first controlled airplane and NASA's quest to put a man on the moon. Header: The header features the "Founders Fund" logo, which includes a stylized design with red and blue stripes. To the right of the logo, there is a menu icon represented by three horizontal lines
